text:
deploy-bot: Deploy r-2026.03.21 -> us-west-2 started. Canary traffic (10%) routed. Running post-deploy smoke + synthetic probes now.
canary-bot: Canary report: embeddings OK. Generations path: p50 stable, p95 +80ms vs baseline. Notable: GPU occupancy ramp slower on new runtime image.
ashley (eng-release): Seeing p95 ~420ms on /v1/generate for long prompts (expected ~320). Repro locally on canary hosts gw-02/gw-03.
mike (sre): Correlating with infra: KV prefix cache miss rate spiked from 2% -> 17% around deploy time on pool gw-03.
jorge (runtime): On it. Quick check: new warmup policy change in rolling config sets prefill_batch=8 -> 2 (intended to reduce cost). That could reduce prefill coverage for long-tail prefixes.
ashley (eng-release): Wait—warmup change was supposed to be gated. Did it roll with this release?
jorge (runtime): Looks like the config flag default flipped in the service config bundle included in this image. Probably an accidental default.
nora (product): This affects interactive latency for chat customers. Recommend pausing rollout until we confirm warmup delta's impact.
mike (sre): Operational suggestion: pin traffic for capacity-tier customers back to r-2026.03.20 and pause remaining canary. We can hotfix config short-term.
ashley (eng-release): I can revert the warmup flag and push a canary patch. ETA ~10m if SRE approves rollback/pin.
mike (sre): Approve pin and hold. I'll run the rollback/pin on the dedicated route for high-QPS tenants.
deploy-bot: Executing traffic pin: routing 100% of capacity-tier customers -> r-2026.03.20 in us-west-2. Pausing remainder of rollout.
canary-bot: Post-pin checks running... KV miss rate on gw-03 trending down -> 2.5%. p95 latency trending to baseline.
ashley (eng-release): Confirmed on dashboard: p95 back to ~325ms, KV miss ~2%. Looks good. I'll prepare a follow-up PR to revert accidental default in main config.
jorge (runtime): Will add a guard in the config validator to prevent non-gated warmup flips from shipping.
mike (sre): Filing incident ticket and adding runbook note for warmup misconfig. Also will schedule a brief postmortem after we close the rollout.
nora (product): Thanks everyone. Keep me posted on the hotfix timeline; we may need to notify a few early customers.
ashley (eng-release): Opening ticket: INF-5628 with perf graphs attached and rollout timeline. I'll update release notes and mark this patch as blocked until warmup revert verified. :white_check_mark:
mike (sre): Great. Once hotfix is validated in canary, we can resume the rollout with canary-bot gating.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Will resume on explicit +release command.
jorge (runtime): Quick note: saved logs snippet (for triage):
```
[gw-03] 2026-03-21T14:02:38Z KV_PREFILL miss rate=17% prefill_batch=2
[gw-03] 2026-03-21T14:03:10Z p95=/v1/generate 420ms
[gw-03] 2026-03-21T14:11:05Z after-pin KV_PREFILL miss rate=2.4% p95=328ms
```
canary-bot: Will re-run synthetic sweep after warmup revert and report.
ashley (eng-release): Thx — closing loop here, will update ticket with timeline and link to hotfix PR. :thumbsup:
